prompt_prefix: hard sci-fi concept art, Syd Mead inspired, clean industrial design, neon accent lighting, chrome and glass, futuristic architecture, cinematic sci-fi quality
prompt_suffix: no text, no watermarks, high detail mechanical design, professional concept art quality, cinematic lighting
negative_prompt: fantasy, medieval, organic, painterly, soft focus, cartoon, anime, low tech, steampunk, magical

mood_modifiers.tense: red warning lights, steam venting, alarms implied, confined spaces, system failure aesthetic
mood_modifiers.joyful: bright clean future, utopian design, natural light through vast windows, hope in technology
mood_modifiers.eerie: abandoned tech, flickering lights, empty corridors, AI presence implied, liminal spaces
mood_modifiers.epic: massive scale engineering, fleet shots, planetary scale structures, technological sublime
mood_modifiers.peaceful: observation deck serenity, stars visible, quiet hum of systems, contemplative future
mood_modifiers.melancholy: derelict ships, fading systems, last transmissions, entropy claiming technology
mood_modifiers.awe: first contact scale, megastructures revealed, dyson spheres, technological transcendence
mood_modifiers.dread: hull breach imminent, alien contamination, something in the ship, isolation of space

scene.wide: establishing shot of installation or ship, scale indicators, environmental storytelling
scene.medium: character at console or viewport, technology interaction, human scale reference
scene.close: interface detail, suit helmet reflection, technological intimacy
scene.low_angle: towering machinery, ship from below, awe at engineering
scene.overhead: tactical display view, ship schematic perspective, strategic overview
scene.default: cinematic sci-fi composition, depth through atmospheric perspective, light sources as design

portrait.default: character in environment suit or uniform, visor reflections optional, professional future aesthetic

location_card.default: station or ship exterior, planet or stars in background, establishing the frontier

item.default: technological artifact on display, holographic elements optional, clean presentation

moment.default: action in zero-g or at speed, energy weapons, ship combat, technological conflict
